findings.problem: It specifies the settings entry as `python3 -I -B <dir>/shadow_hook.py --wb <absolute launcher>`, which omits both `env -i` and an absolute interpreter. This contradicts the Goal, Increment B, and Increment D, and would leave the unsafe, PATH-selected interpreter form in the required owner procedure.
findings.suggestion: Require the exact hardened entry consistently: `/usr/bin/env -i <absolute interpreter> -I -B <dir>/shadow_hook.py --wb <absolute launcher>`.

findings.problem: The planned spec statement that “the real Codex was not tried confined” and that the owner test-set is its first use drifts from `docs/specs/model-bridge.md`’s Confinement section, which records a successful confined `ask-codex` run with Codex CLI on 2026-11-01.
findings.suggestion: Remove that statement, or narrowly distinguish an untried real run of the action-review engine from the already recorded confined bridge run, while preserving the model-bridge evidence.

summary: Two material inconsistencies remain in the hardened installation requirement and the recorded confinement evidence.
